newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India drifts pre-weekend, Reliance off.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India drifts pre-weekend, Reliance off.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts finished quietly easier on Friday as prices consolidated ahead of the weekend after a slow session in Bombay.
Traders said the market had found few fresh influencing factors, with Reliance dipping on profit-taking following losses in Bombay and after firming on Thursday.
Reliance on Thursday announced a one-for-one bonus issue.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 0.46 points softer at 88.69, down 0.52 percent, with the premium over the local market at 25.95 percent from 26.67 percent.
Bombay's benchmark index rose 16.68 points to 4,133.24.
Reliance ended the day 30 cents softer at $22.50/$23.50. SBI lost 12 cents to $25.50/$26.50 and VSNL added 12 cents to $20.25/21.25.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index closed down 0.84 points, or 1.11 percent, at 74.96 points, a premium of 40.74 percent over the local market.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index finished 0.29 points higher at 133.90, representing a discount to the local market of 3.29 percent.
